Applications.title: Applications

Applications received, by where they stand now (never the ones still
being filled in).

CategoryPatch.title: CategoryPatch
CategoryPatch.description: What changes; the kind and the key never do. An icon left out is kept.

CredentialTypePatch.title: CredentialTypePatch
CredentialTypePatch.description: What changes: only what is sent. The key never does.

Credentials.title: Credentials
Credentials.description: Credentials issued, by their status now.

CustomFieldPatch.title: CustomFieldPatch
CustomFieldPatch.description:
What changes: only what is sent. The key never does. `type`,
`max_length`, `pattern`, `options` and `formats` go together: sending any
of them sets the field's definition to what is sent.

DomainPatch.title: DomainPatch
DomainPatch.description:
What changes: only what is sent. The key never does; `codes`, when sent,
is the whole list in its order.

ItemDetail.title: ItemDetail

An issuer, verifier or mediator, opened on its own: with its identity's
DID, the document it should publish and where it is (a draft's is not).

Narrow.title: Narrow
Narrow.description: What a form may make stricter; which apply depends on the field's type.

PartIn.title: PartIn
PartIn.description: One part of a group: a field of its own, named by a key in the group.

RequestObject.title: RequestObject
RequestObject.description: What the wallet reads: who asks, for what, and where to answer.

SignObject.title: SignObject
SignObject.description:
`sign`: what to sign, and what it is.

`did_log_entry`: an identity's next did:webvh log entry, signed with a key
named as a `did:key`. `credential`: a credential an issuer grants a holder,
an SD-JWT VC (`document`: its header, payload and disclosures; see
`registry_api.issuance`), signed as a JWS by the issuer's signer.

x-refusals.credential_type_in_use: Something uses the type, and the change would alter what it is.
x-refusals.issuance_invalid: An account's own types are issued by its issuers (`almena`); only the trust anchor's may be issued elsewhere.
x-refusals.vct_invalid: A `vct` goes with a type issued under its own framework (`external`), and must be a valid URI.
x-refusals.w3c_type_invalid: The W3C type is not a valid name.
x-refusals.mdoc_doctype_invalid: The mdoc doctype is not a valid name.
x-refusals.grants_issuers_only: Only issuers grant credential types: `grants` filters issuers alone.
x-refusals.version_not_found: There is no catalogue of that version.
x-refusals.not_found: Nothing is published there (or not signed yet).
x-refusals.invalid_cursor: The cursor is not one this list gave.
x-refusals.form_not_found: The account has no form by that id.
x-refusals.form_in_use: The form is in use: it may only take more than it took (`field` or `credential` says where).
x-refusals.field_unknown: A field is not in the catalogue (`field` says which).
x-refusals.field_key_invalid: A field's own name is not lower snake case (`field` says which).
x-refusals.field_key_duplicate: Two fields have the same name (`field` says which).
x-refusals.field_narrow_invalid: A field's restriction does not fit it (`field` says which).
x-refusals.field_rename_invalid: Only a repeatable field takes a name of its own (`field` says which).
x-refusals.credential_unknown: A credential asked for is not in the catalogue (`credential` says which).
x-refusals.credential_key_invalid: A credential's name in the form is not valid (`credential` says which).
x-refusals.credential_key_duplicate: Two credentials have the same name in the form (`credential` says which).
x-refusals.credential_type_duplicate: The same credential type is asked for twice (`credential` says which).
x-refusals.credential_claims_invalid: A credential's claims are not fields of its type (`credential` says which).
x-refusals.credential_trust_invalid: Whom a credential is trusted from is not valid (`credential` says which).
x-refusals.request_form_invalid: Not one of the account's forms, or not for a type the issuer grants.
x-refusals.offer_not_found: The issuer does not offer that credential type.
x-refusals.application_not_found: There is no application by that id, or not with this secret.
x-refusals.application_expired: The application was not sent within a day: it is gone.
x-refusals.application_gone: The application is gone or no longer accepted, so the signed credential is not issued.
x-refusals.application_not_paired: Pair a wallet with the application first.
x-refusals.application_closed: The application has been sent already.
x-refusals.already_paired: A wallet is paired with the application already.
x-refusals.answers_invalid: Some answers do not meet the form (`errors` says which and why).
x-refusals.answers_incomplete: Answer the form, and present the credentials it needs, before sending.
x-refusals.nothing_to_present: The form asks for no credentials.
x-refusals.not_the_holder: It is signed by another key than the wallet that paired.
x-refusals.digest_mismatch: The digest is not that of the application's content.
x-refusals.file_field_unknown: The form asks for no file by that key.
x-refusals.file_too_large: The file is larger than the form allows.
x-refusals.file_type_invalid: The form does not accept that kind of file.
x-refusals.file_not_found: The application has no file by that key.
x-refusals.already_received: The credential has been taken already.
x-refusals.not_issued: The credential has not been issued yet.
x-refusals.already_issued: The credential has been issued already.
x-refusals.not_paired: No wallet is paired with the application, so there is no holder to issue to.
x-refusals.no_draft: There is no credential prepared to sign: save its claims first.
x-refusals.valid_until_invalid: The end of validity must be after today.
x-refusals.not_the_issuers_signer: Only the issuer's signer may do this.
x-refusals.status_list_unsigned: The issuer's status list must be signed first.
x-refusals.status_list_not_found: The issuer has no status list by that id.
x-refusals.status_list_changed: The status list changed while it was being signed: sign again.
x-refusals.status_list_gone: The status list is no longer there.
x-refusals.no_status_list: Issued before status lists: it cannot be suspended or revoked.
x-refusals.status_unchanged: The credential already has that status.
x-refusals.credential_revoked: The credential is revoked: that is final.
x-refusals.verification_not_found: The verifier has no verification by that id.

x-presentation-problems.format_invalid: It is not a well-formed SD-JWT VC.
x-presentation-problems.disclosure_invalid: A disclosure is not one the credential lists.
x-presentation-problems.holder_binding_invalid: The key-binding JWT is missing or not by the credential's key.
x-presentation-problems.audience_mismatch: It was presented to someone else.
x-presentation-problems.nonce_mismatch: It was presented for another request.
x-presentation-problems.type_mismatch: It is not of the type asked for.
x-presentation-problems.claims_missing: It lacks data the request needs.
x-presentation-problems.issuer_unresolvable: Its issuer's DID could not be resolved.
x-presentation-problems.issuer_untrusted: Its issuer is not one the request trusts.
x-presentation-problems.trust_framework_unsupported: Credentials of its framework cannot be verified yet.
x-presentation-problems.status_unverifiable: Its status list could not be read or believed.
